title: Selected restriction and left extension preserve normalization
statement: Let B be an inverse sequence of commutative ring sheaves on a site, S a SystemLevelLeftExtensionTheory [def-pur-system-level-left-extension-basic], and r an order embedding of the natural numbers. Define normalized(A,M) to mean invertibility of every scalar-adjoint transition from n to m for all m≤n. Exact selected restriction U_r sends normalized B-systems to normalized selected B_r-systems. The actual selected left extension L_r sends normalized selected B_r-systems to normalized B-systems. No bound, constructibility or coefficient flatness is assumed.

proof.text: For arbitrary m≤n, put a=t(m), b=t(n); minimality gives a≤b. The canonical full transition composition law and subsequence transition square give the right-adjoint cocone identity for these two levels. selectedDerivedTranspose at the identity supplies the two evaluation transpose equations. Apply adjunctionTransition_coherence to this cocone: the recovered transition-adjoint is a composite of evaluation isomorphisms, canonical left-adjoint-uniqueness associators and scalar extension of the normalized selected transition-adjoint. Every factor is invertible. This works for arbitrary m≤n, including a=b and m=n.

lean.statement:
theorem systemSelectedNormalization
    (S : SystemLevelLeftExtensionTheory (J := J))
    (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}) (r : ℕ ↪o ℕ) :
    let normalized := fun (A : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w})
        (M : DerivedCategory (StrictRingSystem A)) ↦
      ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n),
        IsIso (((systemDerivedTensorAdj S.scalar A h).homEquiv _ _).symm
          ((S.transition A h).app M))
    (∀ M, normalized B M →
      normalized (selectedSystemRings B r) ((derivedSystemSubsequence B r).obj M)) ∧
    (∀ N, normalized (selectedSystemRings B r) N →
      normalized B ((S.selected B r).derived.obj N))
